source(output(
		PhoneNumber as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @Phones TABLE (PhoneNumber NVARCHAR(12),OrderNum INT IDENTITY(1,1))  INSERT INTO @Phones (PhoneNumber) SELECT DISTINCT T.PhoneNumber FROM ##tmpPhoneNumbers T 	INNER JOIN PDS_DONOTCALLPHONE DNC ON T.PhoneNumber = DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_PHONENUMBER 		AND DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_ACTIVE_IND = 1 WHERE CASE WHEN DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_WRONG_PHN_NBR_IND = 0 OR DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_WRONG_PHN_NBR_IND IS NULL THEN \'DNC\' WHEN DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_WRONG_PHN_NBR_IND = 1 AND (DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_RND_IND = 0 OR DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_RND_IND IS NULL) THEN \'Wrong Number\' WHEN DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_WRONG_PHN_NBR_IND = 1 AND DNC.DONOTCALLPHONE_RND_IND = 1 THEN \'RND\' ELSE \'UNK\' END IN (\'RND\',\'Wrong Number\')  DECLARE @M INT SELECT @M = MAX(OrderNum) FROM @Phones  SELECT \'\'\'91\' + PhoneNumber + \'\'\'\' + CASE WHEN OrderNum = @M THEN \'\' ELSE \',\' END AS PhoneNumber FROM @Phones ORDER BY OrderNum',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		PhoneNumber as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PhoneNumber)) ~> FlatFileDestination
